description.value: North Point Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and tasting room founded by three North Shore locals, situated in North Vancouver's lively Shipyards District. The space leans into a cozy West Coast cabin aesthetic, with both indoor and outdoor seating and a rotating tap list of house-brewed beers ranging from session lagers to high-ABV IPAs. A private loft with views of the North Shore and downtown Vancouver can host events, and the brewery welcomes guests of all ages.

address.value: 266 1st St E, North Vancouver, British Columbia V7L 1B3
